description: Header file defining the MTIAHooksInterface class for integrating MTIA backend with PyTorch, including method declarations, constants, and registry setup.

classes.name: MTIAHooksInterface
classes.description: Interface class for MTIA backend hooks, providing methods for device management, stream control, memory management, and graph operations.

methods.name: deviceCount
methods.description: Returns the number of MTIA devices.

methods.name: getCurrentStream
methods.description: Retrieves the current stream for a device.

methods.name: getDefaultStream
methods.description: Retrieves the default stream for a device.

methods.name: memoryStats
methods.description: Returns memory statistics for a device.

methods.name: getDefaultGenerator
methods.description: Returns the default generator for a device.

methods.name: getNewGenerator
methods.description: Returns a new generator for a device.
